summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, to disclose a TR-1 notification regarding a major holding. Artisan Partners Limited Partnership reported a reduction in its voting rights from 12.02% to 11.99%, now holding 72,066,708 shares. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of a passive crossing of a notifiable threshold under UK rules, equivalent to a Schedule 13D/A or 13G filing in the US. No tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic transaction is announced. The filing is a standard ongoing notification without any special-situation event. What to watch: no further action required; this is a mechanical filing reflecting Artisan's minor position adjustment.
